title: STP Calculator
formula_verified: STP: Transfer fixed amount from source fund to target fund periodically. Source Fund FV = Initial × (1+r_s)^n − T × [(1+r_s)^n − 1]/r_s; Target Fund FV = T × [(1+r_t)^n − 1]/r_t × (1+r_t). T = monthly transfer, r_s/r_t = monthly return of source/target.

what_is: A STP Calculator is a digital tool that allows you to systematic transfer plan without complex manual calculations. In the Indian financial ecosystem, accurate calculations are crucial given dynamic tax slabs, RBI interest rate changes, SEBI regulations, and government scheme updates. This calculator incorporates all India-specific parameters to give you precise, actionable results.
how_to_use: Step 1: Open the STP Calculator on this page. Step 2: Enter your Initial Source Fund Amount (₹) (e.g., ₹100,000). Step 3: Enter your Monthly Transfer Amount (₹) (e.g., ₹10,000). Step 4: Enter your Source Fund Annual Return (%) (e.g., ₹6). Step 5: Enter your Target Fund Annual Return (%) (e.g., ₹12). Step 6: Enter your STP Duration (Years) (e.g., ₹2). Step 7: Click 'Calculate' to see instant results. Step 8: Review the detailed breakdown and use results for financial planning. Step 9: Adjust inputs to explore different scenarios.
formula_explanation: The STP Calculator uses: STP: Transfer fixed amount from source fund to target fund periodically. Source Fund FV = Initial × (1+r_s)^n − T × [(1+r_s)^n − 1]/r_s; Target Fund FV = T × [(1+r_t)^n − 1]/r_t × (1+r_t). T = monthly. Each variable is derived from your inputs with Indian regulatory parameters.
